tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Search the Alltools Geelong catalogue and return matching products with price, stock status, SKU and a link. Read-only — does not add anything to the cart.

query.description: Keywords to search for, e.g. "cordless drill", a brand, or a model number.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-10). Defaults to 5.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Alltools Geelong product catalogue by keyword and show matching products.
